events.title: Update 1.4: launching 5 November, with a profit bridge and Save Slots
events.summary: Novalex Project Zero is a car-company tycoon: design cars, build production lines and compete with rival companies. It launches on 5 November, and Version 1.4.0 is the final big update before launch. The free demo is live now. If you enjoy it, wishlist the full game to hear the moment it launches. Why you made or lost money The new profit bridge on the dashboard goes step by step from revenue to net result, so you can see which cost changed your result without opening a report. events.title: The demo arrives 12 August, with controller and Steam Input support
events.summary: The demo opens on 12 August This is the build it ships from. Most of the work since the last update went into two things: making the game behave on hardware it had never been properly tested on, and correcting parts of the simulation that were quietly wrong. Controller and Steam Input support You can play the whole game on a pad. events.title: A Complete Visual Redesign, a Guided Tutorial, and Steam Deck Support
events.summary: Update 1.2 This is the biggest update Novalex Project Zero has had. Nearly every screen has been rebuilt, there is a proper tutorial for new players, and the game now behaves itself on a Steam Deck and on very wide monitors. What's new A complete visual redesign. The garage, car designer, reports and research used to live inside stacked pop-up dialogs. events.title: The Novalex Project Zero Playtest Is Now Open
events.summary: The Novalex Project Zero Playtest Is Now Open Build your own car company from a single garage into a global manufacturer. Design cars, research new tech, set up production lines, price your lineup, and outmaneuver around 30 AI rivals in a turn based market that reacts to every move you make. The playtest is open to everyone right now, and we would love your help shaping the game before launch.
